opportunities.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant — Power Transformation Lab
opportunities.eligibility: Undergraduate students · Python or Julia proficiency
opportunities.description: The Power Transformation Lab is hiring multiple undergraduate research assistants for projects running October 2026 – June 2027, covering data extraction and visualization, statistical analysis, and independent research on macro energy systems.
opportunities.responsibilities: Extract and scrape data from documents and websites; build data visualizations; perform basic statistical analysis; contribute to independent research projects.
opportunities.requirements: Cover letter describing your interests and relevant experience; resume. Proficiency in Python or Julia required. GIS, database, or AI-tool experience is a plus.
opportunities.process: Apply through the Handshake job posting (ID 11459763) and follow the instructions listed there.
opportunities.funding: Paid hourly position — see Handshake posting for details
opportunities.keywords: energy research assistant python julia data visualization handshake

opportunities.title: Cal-in-Sacramento Fellowship
opportunities.org: Matsui Center for Politics and Public Service
opportunities.eligibility: UC Berkeley undergraduates passionate about public service
opportunities.description: One of UC's largest campus-based public service programs. Fellows take a 3-unit spring course on California policy and politics plus professional development and research training, then complete an eight-week summer internship in Sacramento — in Senate and Assembly offices, the Governor's Office, state agencies, think tanks, or nonprofits. 25–30 fellows selected each year.
opportunities.responsibilities: Spring coursework and research training; full-time summer public-service internship with a Sacramento host office.
opportunities.requirements: Online application; see program page for full requirements and eligibility details.
opportunities.process: Apply via the Matsui Center's 2026–27 program application page before the deadline.
opportunities.funding: Free shared housing in Sacramento + transportation and living stipend
opportunities.keywords: public service internship sacramento policy politics fellowship

opportunities.title: Undergraduate Research Apprentice Program (URAP) — Spring 2027
opportunities.deadlineNote: Representative date — applications open for a two-week window after the first day of the spring semester
opportunities.description: Work directly with faculty and research staff on cutting-edge projects across every school and college at Berkeley. Apprentices deepen their knowledge in an area of special interest while experiencing life in a research community.
opportunities.responsibilities: Varies by project — lab work, data analysis, fieldwork, literature review, participant recruitment, and more.
opportunities.requirements: Online application via the URAP portal, including a statement of interest and research-relevant coursework.
opportunities.process: Browse spring projects on the URAP portal when the application window opens; interview with mentors; file a Learning Contract if selected.
opportunities.funding: Academic credit — 1 unit per 3 hours of research per week (up to 4 units/term)
opportunities.keywords: urap apprentice faculty mentor research credit

opportunities.title: Undergraduate Research Apprentice Program (URAP) — Fall 2026
opportunities.description: The Fall 2026 URAP application window (including the extended application) has closed. Watch for the Spring 2027 cycle, which opens for a two-week window after the first day of the spring semester.
opportunities.responsibilities: See the Spring 2027 listing for program details.
opportunities.process: Applications are closed for this cycle.
opportunities.funding: Academic credit — 1 unit per 3 hours of research per week (up to 4 units/term)

opportunities.title: SUPERB 2027 — Summer Undergraduate Program in Engineering Research at Berkeley (AI4E)
opportunities.org: Dept. of Electrical Engineering & Computer Sciences (EECS)
opportunities.deadlineNote: Representative date — based on the prior cycle's late-January deadline
opportunities.eligibility: Undergraduates · juniors/seniors preferred · interest in AI for Engineering
opportunities.description: A 9-week summer REU site (June–August) focused on Artificial Intelligence for Engineering: machine learning algorithms, safety in human-robot interaction, provably-safe AI systems, adversarial robustness, and engineering design influenced by large language models.
opportunities.responsibilities: Full-time summer research project with an EECS faculty mentor and graduate students; weekly presentations; lab tours; industry field trip; graduate-school advising.
opportunities.requirements: Online application; personal statement demonstrating interest in the research theme.
opportunities.process: Apply through the SUPERB program page; decisions typically announced in spring.
opportunities.funding: Stipend + room and board at International House
opportunities.keywords: superb reu summer engineering ai machine learning stipend housing

opportunities.title: SURF L&S — Summer Undergraduate Research Fellowship 2027
opportunities.deadlineNote: Representative date — based on the prior cycle's mid-March deadline
opportunities.eligibility: L&S undergraduates with junior/senior standing · 3.0+ GPA · faculty mentor required
opportunities.description: Seven weeks of full-time, faculty-mentored summer research on an independent project of your own design — culminating in a senior thesis or other capstone project. Includes a research cluster community, workshops, and the SURF Conference in August.
opportunities.responsibilities: Design and execute an original summer research project full-time for at least seven weeks; present at the SURF Conference.
opportunities.requirements: Well-written research proposal; committed UC Berkeley faculty mentor; attend an application workshop or advising consultation before applying.
opportunities.process: Submit the online application with proposal and mentor commitment; see the SURF page for the current cycle's instructions.
opportunities.keywords: surf fellowship summer independent research thesis capstone

opportunities.title: Haas Scholars Program 2026–27
opportunities.deadlineNote: Representative date — confirm on the official page
opportunities.eligibility: Seniors graduating Fall 2026 or Spring/Summer 2027 · 3.450+ GPA · eligible for need-based financial aid
opportunities.description: A year-long funded senior capstone for 20 scholars selected across the humanities, STEM, and social sciences. Close mentoring from UC Berkeley faculty, interdisciplinary cohort seminars and workshops, and a professional conference presentation.
opportunities.responsibilities: Carry out an original, feasible senior research or creative project (~10 hrs/week); participate in cohort events throughout the year.
opportunities.requirements: Project proposal (research statement, background, plan, qualifications, bibliography, budget); faculty sponsor; professional reference.
opportunities.process: Apply online when the application opens in early fall; applications are read by discipline-based selection committees.
opportunities.keywords: haas scholars senior capstone fellowship cohort funded

opportunities.title: Rose Hills Summer Program 2027
opportunities.deadlineNote: Representative date — confirm on the official page
opportunities.eligibility: Undergraduates in the sciences and engineering
opportunities.description: A summer research program supporting Berkeley undergraduates in the sciences and engineering who are pursuing faculty-mentored research projects over the summer.
opportunities.responsibilities: Full-time summer research with a faculty mentor; program activities vary by year.
opportunities.requirements: Online application; faculty mentor support recommended — see the program page for current requirements.
opportunities.process: Apply via the Rose Hills program page during the application window.
opportunities.keywords: rose hills summer sciences engineering funding

opportunities.title: Data Science Discovery Program — Spring 2027
opportunities.org: College of Computing, Data Science, and Society (CDSS)
opportunities.deadlineNote: Applications posted before the start of each semester
opportunities.eligibility: UC Berkeley undergraduates · all majors welcome
opportunities.description: Semester-long, team-based data science projects with industry, government, nonprofit, and academic partners. Past projects include visualizing natural-disaster data with the SF Chronicle, predicting train delays with BART using ML, and NLP for personalized treatment plans with UCSF. 1,000+ projects over 10 years.
opportunities.responsibilities: Work in a small student team on a partner-led project; weekly team meetings; end-of-semester showcase.
opportunities.requirements: Online application on the CDSS Undergraduate Student Opportunities Application Hub; teams are matched by research interests.
opportunities.process: Apply before the semester starts; project matching is done by program staff.
opportunities.funding: Academic credit (student researcher roles are unpaid)
opportunities.keywords: discovery data science team project nlp machine learning

opportunities.responsibilities: Summer research in a College of Chemistry lab; program activities vary by year.
opportunities.requirements: Online application — see the program page for current requirements.
opportunities.process: Fill out the online application linked on the SURD program page.

opportunities.title: EECS Faculty Labs — Undergraduate Research (EECS 199)
opportunities.org: Dept. of Electrical Engineering & Computer Sciences (EECS)
opportunities.deadlineNote: Contact labs directly — many hire on a rolling basis
opportunities.eligibility: EECS undergraduates · faculty supervisor approval required
opportunities.description: Independent research with EECS faculty — from AI, robotics, and systems to circuits and theory. Many labs (including BAIR-affiliated groups) take undergraduates during the academic year, typically via EECS 199 independent study or URAP.
opportunities.responsibilities: Varies by lab — software development, experiments, data analysis, literature review, and research meetings.
opportunities.requirements: Identify a faculty supervisor; major advisor approval; enroll in EECS 199 for units.
opportunities.process: Browse faculty research areas, email professors with your resume and interests, or apply through URAP listings.
opportunities.funding: Academic credit (EECS 199); some labs offer hourly pay
opportunities.keywords: eecs faculty lab 199 bair ai robotics research assistant
